attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited announced the approval of its Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The financial statements include the operations of the holding company and three subsidiaries: Solex Green Energy Private Limited, Solex New Energy Private Limited, and Solex BESS Private Limited. Statutory auditors M/s Maheshwari & Co. issued a Limited Review Report with no modifications or qualifications. Solex Green Energy Private Limited reported revenue of Rs 212.22 million and profit of Rs 2.97 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company operates in the solar energy market, manufacturing modules and providing Engineering, Procurement, and Construction services. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange platforms.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited has scheduled a post-earnings conference call for Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. The call will discuss the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Management representatives include Mr. Vipul Shah, Non-Executive Director, Mr. Hemal Kachiwala, Chief Financial Officer, and Dr. Chetan Shah, Chairman and Managing Director. Participants can dial in using the provided universal and international numbers. Pre-registration is available via a link on the company website. Contact details for Rushabh Shah and Logeshwari Ayyer are provided for further information. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange change in the Corporate Office of the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) of the Company with effect from December 01, 2026.
